C1073.title: Busted! Influencer with 5 Million Followers Arrested for Staging Hidden Camera Hoaxes
C1073.summary: From September to November 2023, a former shareholder of a Sichuan-based IT company organized individuals to illegally install hidden cameras in hotel rooms across Leshan, Hanzhong, Shijiazhuang, and other locations, registering the camera MAC addresses into the backend database of their company's 'anti-spy camera detector'.
